2608.28393.title: Timing-Aware Repurchase Prediction for Web-Scale E-Commerce: Survival Models for Multi-Surface Grocery Recommendation
2608.28393.paper_summary: Repurchase recommenders in e-commerce are commonly framed as a binary question asking "will this customer buy this item within W days", a formulation that requires a separately trained model for every horizon of interest. We replace this stack with survival models that predict time-to-repurchase directly, and evaluate them on millions of customers from a major grocery e-commerce platform across more than thirty ablation configurations. Our study makes three contributions. First, an empirical hazard analysis reveals a slightly decreasing marginal hazard (k ~ 0.9), differing from the common intuition that grocery items become more likely to be repurchased the longer since the last purchase (increasing hazard, k > 1). Log-Normal achieves the best marginal fit (R^2 = 0.998) and the best ranking, despite Weibull providing the best conditional residual fit, revealing an apparent discrepancy we analyze in detail. Second, a single Accelerated Failure Time (AFT) model replaces three per-horizon binary classifiers, matching or exceeding each at its own horizon while using roughly 3x fewer total trees. Feature importance reshuffles under the survival objective: channel-cadence and recency signals rise while aggregate frequency counts fall. Third, a 4-parameter parametric calibration maps raw survival CDFs to per-horizon probabilities with zero cross-horizon monotonicity violations. Calibration quality varies by an order of magnitude across the AFT family: Exponential AFT (Weibull k=1) achieves expected calibration error (ECE) ~1e-4, roughly 10x lower than Log-Normal, while ranking metrics agree within 0.3% relative. We adopt Exponential AFT for probability-consuming surfaces and Log-Normal for pure ranking, exposing a principled calibration-ranking trade-off within a single AFT family.
2608.28393.paper_summary_zh: 電子商務中的回購推薦通常被框架為一個二元問題，詢問「這位顧客會在 W 天內購買這個商品嗎」，這種表述需要為每個感興趣的時間範圍訓練一個單獨的模型。我們用生存模型取代這一堆疊，直接預測回購的時間，並在來自一個主要的雜貨電子商務平台的數百萬顧客上進行評估，涵蓋超過三十種消融配置。我們的研究有三個貢獻。首先，經驗危險分析顯示邊際危險略微下降（k ~ 0.9），這與常見的直覺相悖，即雜貨商品在距離上次購買的時間越長時，更可能被回購（增加的危險，k > 1）。對數正態模型達到了最佳的邊際擬合（R^2 = 0.998）和最佳排名，儘管威布爾模型提供了最佳的條件殘差擬合，這揭示了一個明顯的差異，我們將詳細分析。第二，單一的加速失效時間（AFT）模型取代了三個每個時間範圍的二元分類器，在各自的時間範圍內匹配或超過每個分類器，同時使用的總樹數約為三分之一。特徵重要性在生存目標下重新排序：渠道頻率和最近性信號上升，而總體頻率計數下降。第三，四參數的參數校準將原始生存 CDF 映射到每個時間範圍的概率，且沒有跨時間範圍的單調性違規。校準質量在 AFT 家族中差異達一個數量級：指數 AFT（威布爾 k=1）達到了預期校準誤差（ECE）約為 1e-4，這大約比對數正態模型低 10 倍，而排名指標的相對一致性在 0.3% 內。我們採用指數 AFT 用於概率消耗的表面，並用對數正態模型進行純排名，揭示了在單一 AFT 家族內的原則性校準-排名權衡。
